currentEpic.description: 1833 单元测试维持历史最高水位，但 E2E 测试仍有 1 skipped + 1 flaky（pre-existing 空数据测试）。QA 长期关注的测试基础设施需要系统性升级：E2E 稳定化、并行执行、视觉回归测试、性能回归测试，确保从单元测试到端到端测试的全链路质量保障。

steps: Step 1: Add data-testid attributes to MoreMenu component for stable E2E locators
Step 2: Add data-testid attributes to NavigationContext/MobileNav for stable navigation locators
Step 3: Stabilize complete-flow.spec.ts MoreMenu navigation tests with data-testid selectors
Step 4: Stabilize data-management.spec.ts navigation tests with data-testid selectors
Step 5: Fix practice.spec.ts navigation with proper baseURL handling and waiting
Step 6: Add page.waitForLoadState('networkidle') and content verification to all navigation steps
Step 7: Update unit test mocks for App.tsx to include new data-testid attributes
Step 8: Run E2E tests and verify all 3 spec files pass consistently
Step 9: Run full test suite to verify 1833 unit tests remain unaffected
Step 10: Run build and lint to verify no regressions
